지적.수정방향: 커밋 대상을 검수할 때 변경된 배포 파일이 있는 작업 트리를 거부하거나 해당 파일도 함께 검수하거나, 정확히 검수한 트리에서 지문을 계산합니다.

원문:
The review ledger can associate a successful review with deployable content that Codex never inspected, undermining the new deployment gate's core invariant.

Review comment:

- [P1] Bind the recorded fingerprint to the reviewed target — C:\Users\q1212\Documents\SYNK-appsscript\tools\codex-review.js:359-359
  When `--commit` or `--base` is used while the working tree contains different deploy-file changes, Codex reviews only the selected commit/range, but this records `지문맵()` from the current working tree. The gate can therefore treat unreviewed working-tree bytes as reviewed and allow their deployment. Refuse dirty deploy files for committed targets, review them too, or compute the fingerprint from the exact reviewed tree.

원문:
The Gemini policy is not connected to any request, and several selector inputs silently run a different model than requested. The key setup guidance also introduces an avoidable credential-exposure path.

Full review comments:

- [P1] Wire the Gemini setting into a request path — C:\Users\q1212\Documents\SYNK-appsscript\tools\모델정책.js:153-157
  When any Gemini task runs after this commit, `제미나이설정` is never consulted: the existing request path in `tools/몽골어대조.js` still hard-codes `gemini-3.6-flash` and sends no `thinking_level`, while no live-sheet caller was added. Wire this policy into an actual request path; otherwise the Gemini half is inert and violates the same-commit activation rule at `CLAUDE.md:43`.

- [P2] Keep the Gemini key out of PowerShell history — C:\Users\q1212\Documents\SYNK-appsscript\tools\모델정책.js:206-206
  When the user follows this remediation with the real key, the literal secret is persisted in PSReadLine history and potentially an agent/tool transcript. The repository already keeps this credential in `SYNK_보안/제미나이.txt` and supports `GEMINI_KEY_PATH`; load that file or use a non-echoing one-shot mechanism instead.

- [P2] Validate versioned picker aliases exactly — C:\Users\q1212\Documents\SYNK-appsscript\tools\모델정책.js:81-81
  Because every non-letter is removed before validation, inputs such as `gpt-4-luna` or `5.5 luna max` normalize to `luna` and silently select `gpt-5.6-luna`. This defeats the stated typo-rejection behavior; validate the `5.6` portion for full aliases or accept only the short `sol`/`luna` names.

- [P2] Fail closed on legacy or incomplete selector flags — C:\Users\q1212\Documents\SYNK-appsscript\tools\codex-review.js:380-380
  When an existing invocation still uses the parent revision's `--모델 <name>` option, it is now ignored and the review runs with `sol/max`; similarly, a bare `--검수` passes `undefined` and is treated as the default. Reject or translate the legacy flag and distinguish an omitted selector from a selector whose value is missing.

원문:
The patch fixes the reported status-chain false positive, but its new lexical commit count can treat output from another commit-producing Git command as proof that the monitored commit landed, causing the guard to miss real no-ops.

Review comment:

- [P2] Scope landing counts to actual commit commands — C:\Users\q1212\Documents\SYNK-appsscript\.claude\hooks\commit-noop-guard.js:74-75
  When one Bash/PowerShell invocation runs another commit-producing command such as `git cherry-pick <sha> && git commit ...`, the cherry-pick emits `[branch <sha>]` while `커밋수` remains 1. The `착지수 >= 커밋수` check then exits before examining the later `nothing to commit`, silently missing the no-op; this workflow is in scope because `git-scope-guard.js` treats cherry-pick/revert/merge as commit-generating commands. Associate landing output with each actual invocation instead of using this lexical total.

원문:
The new no-track path can discard an existing board continuation when ownership evidence is incomplete, unreadable, or inconsistent, and it also drops a required freshness check. These are correctness issues in the handoff mechanism.

Full review comments:

- [P1] Do not treat hash-shaped text as proof of track ownership — C:\Users\q1212\Documents\SYNK-appsscript\.claude\hooks\lib\session-report.js:146-146
  When a row contains a commit-looking token that is not returned by `myCommits` (for example, a trailerless sibling-repository commit), `boardTrack` returns null but `무주줄` excludes that row solely because it matches this regex. If it is the only such row, the handoff takes the `모호 === 0` path, says the board need not be reopened, and starts a new track even though the row may belong to the current session. A hash-shaped marker is not proof that the current session was ruled out; verify ownership or keep the row ambiguous.

- [P1] Require a readable board before creating a new track — C:\Users\q1212\Documents\SYNK-appsscript\.claude\hooks\lib\session-report.js:205-212
  When `무주줄` returns `null` because `docs/세션보드.md` cannot be read, this fallback still ends with an instruction to create a new track. A read failure does not establish that the current session has no board row, so a transient permission or filesystem error can cause a duplicate track and lose the existing continuation; reserve the automatic new-track instruction for a confirmed zero, and require the board to be read otherwise.

- [P2] Keep the latest-commit check in no-track handoffs — C:\Users\q1212\Documents\SYNK-appsscript\.claude\hooks\lib\session-report.js:210-212
  The previous no-track handoff ended with `git log --oneline -10`, but the new branch removes that freshness check. If another session commits after this handoff is generated, the next session can choose work from stale history and collide with it; the repository explicitly requires this check immediately before starting work (`CLAUDE.md:77`).

- [P2] Use one board snapshot for both no-track decisions — C:\Users\q1212\Documents\SYNK-appsscript\.claude\hooks\lib\session-report.js:162-162
  `buildHandoff` reads the board once through `boardTrack` and then reads it again through `무주줄`. With the documented concurrent sessions, another edit between those calls can make the track lookup and ambiguity count describe different versions, allowing the `모호 === 0` branch to claim that no own row exists; read and parse one snapshot for both decisions (`CLAUDE.md:72`).

- [P2] Classify board rows without requiring an ISO date — C:\Users\q1212\Documents\SYNK-appsscript\.claude\hooks\lib\session-report.js:144-144
  `무주줄` only considers lines containing a `YYYY-MM-DD` token, while the existing board guard treats any non-header, non-separator table row as data (`.claude/hooks/board-guard.js:89-95`). A legacy or manually entered row with another date format or a blank date is therefore skipped; if it is the current unmarked row, the count can become zero and the handoff will incorrectly skip the safe board recheck.
